Which hospitals received the most Medicare inpatient payments in 2021?
Medicare Inpatient Hospitals By Provider And Service

SELECT rndrng_prvdr_org_name AS hospital, rndrng_prvdr_state_abrvtn AS state, round(sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double) * try_cast(avg_mdcr_pymt_amt AS double))) AS medicare_paid FROM govblock_health.medicare_inpatient_hospitals_by_provider_and_service WHERE source_file LIKE '%DY21%' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What do pharmacies pay on average for one 20 mg atorvastatin tablet?

SELECT round(avg(try_cast(nadac_per_unit AS double)), 4) AS cost_per_tablet FROM govblock_health.medicaid_nadac WHERE ndc_description LIKE 'ATORVASTATIN 20 MG TAB%' AND substr(effective_date, 7, 4) = '2024'
Which industries hold the most water discharge permits?
SELECT sic_desc, count(DISTINCT npdes_id) AS permits FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_sics GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many current reports on Form 8-K did companies file in 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS current_reports FROM govblock_sec.submissions_filings WHERE form = '8-K' AND substr(cast(filingdate AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2024'
How many people were hired across the U.S. economy in December 2024?
SELECT value AS hires_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_jt_data WHERE series_id = 'JTS000000000000000HIL' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
What share of hazardous waste enforcement actions does EPA take, rather than the states?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN trim(enforcement_agency) = 'E' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_enforcements
Which countries supplied the most smartphones to the United States in 2023?

SELECT c.cty_name, sum(try_cast(d.gen_val_yr AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_trade.census_imp_detl AS d JOIN govblock_trade.census_imports_country AS c ON c.cty_code = d.cty_code WHERE d.commodity LIKE '851713%' AND d.year = '2023' AND d.month = '12' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Materials Project entries are theoretical, with no known lab synthesis?
SELECT count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE cast(theoretical AS varchar) = 'true'
Which states are home to the most trademark owners' filings?
SELECT own_addr_state_cd AS state, count(DISTINCT serial_no) AS filings FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_owner WHERE own_addr_state_cd <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much energy did New York State consume in 2023, in billion Btu?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS billion_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id = 'SEDS.TETCB.NY.A' AND period = '2023'
Which neighbouring grids did New York trade the most power with in 2023?

SELECT directly_interconnected_balancing_authority, sum(abs(try_cast(interchange_mw AS double))) AS mwh_traded FROM govblock_solar.eia930_interchange WHERE balancing_authority = 'NYIS' AND data_date LIKE '%/2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What were the combined year-end net assets reported on Schedule H?
SELECT sum(try_cast(net_assets_eoy_amt AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_h
Which utility territories have the most recorded solar installations?

SELECT utility_service_territory, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE utility_service_territory <> '-1' AND utility_service_territory IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many applications in the examination file went on to issue as patents?
SELECT count(*) AS granted FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE patent_number <> ''
Under which approval pathways are listed drugs marketed?
SELECT marketing_category, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_ndc WHERE marketing_category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average size of a home loan made in California in 2023?
SELECT avg(try_cast(loan_amount AS double)) AS avg_loan FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND state_code = 'CA' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1'
Which medical specialties write the most Medicare prescriptions for insulin glargine?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT prscrbr_type, sum(try_cast(tot_clms AS double)) AS claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE gnrc_name LIKE 'Insulin Glargine%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the WTI crude oil spot price on April 20, 2020?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_barrel FROM govblock_energy.eia_pet_data WHERE series_id = 'PET.RWTC.D' AND period = '20200420'
Which Medicaid managed care plans enrolled the most people in 2017?
Medicaid Managed Care Enrollment By Program And Plan

SELECT plan_name, state, try_cast(total_enrollment AS double) AS enrollees FROM govblock_health.medicaid_managed_care_enrollment_by_program_and_plan WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2017' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many recall campaigns were opened each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls WHERE substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which investment managers have filed the most 13F holdings reports?
SELECT filingmanager_name, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_coverpage WHERE reporttype = '13F HOLDINGS REPORT' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many CRS reports in the library mention China in their titles?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'CRS' AND lower(title) LIKE '%china%'
Which procedures did doctors perform most often for Medicare patients in 2019?
Medicare Physician Other Practitioners By Geography And Service

SELECT hcpcs_desc AS service, sum(try_cast(tot_srvcs AS double)) AS services FROM govblock_health.medicare_physician_other_practitioners_by_geography_and_service WHERE rndrng_prvdr_geo_lvl = 'National' AND source_file LIKE '%D19_Geo%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of the Southwest Power Pool's electricity came from wind in 2023?

SELECT round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind AS double), try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind_without_integrated_battery_storage AS double))) / sum(try_cast(net_generation_mw AS double)), 1) AS wind_pct FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'SWPP' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
Which offices appeared on the most ballots in North Carolina in 2020?

SELECT office, count(DISTINCT precinct) AS precincts FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'NORTH CAROLINA' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average in-state tuition and fees at public colleges that mainly award bachelor's degrees?
SELECT avg(try_cast(tuitionfee_in AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution WHERE cast(control AS varchar) = '1' AND cast(preddeg AS varchar) = '3'
What kinds of insurance do Texans complain about most?
SELECT coverage_type, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_insurance_filings.tx_insurance_complaints GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of single audits filed change from 2017 to 2024?
SELECT audit_year AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_executive.fac_general WHERE audit_year IN ('2017', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which EPA divisions bring the most enforcement cases?
SELECT hq_division, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_enforcements WHERE hq_division IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many wrecks and underwater obstructions does the PR100 study map around Puerto Rico?
Which companies have received the most recorded patent assignments?
SELECT ee_name, count(*) AS assignments FROM govblock_patents.assign_assignee GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many plant patent applications are on file?
SELECT count(*) AS plant_applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE invention_type = 'PLT'
Which states produced the most wind power in 2024?

SELECT substr(series_id, 14, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'ELEC.GEN.WND-%-99.A' AND length(series_id) = 20 AND substr(series_id, 14, 2) <> 'US' AND period = '2024' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
